description: Returns this connection's own usage for the last 1 to 30 days (days=1 is today since 00:00 Asia/Taipei): summary (calls, units, errors, by_endpoint) and recent calls (request_id, endpoint, status, units, at), newest first, limit 1 to 100, cursor for the next page. Only this connection's records. Applies when the user asks what this connection did, or a request_id is needed to report a problem.
name: get_my_usage
title: My usage and call log
